subject: Security & ID proofing: SSO/SCIM evidence request and next steps
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@wellbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Security & ID proofing: SSO/SCIM evidence request and next steps

Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all stay aligned.

Recap (short):
- Demo went well; goal is to replace current host-based NLG pipeline and run inference behind customer VPC for PHI workloads.
- Key compliance asks: SOC 2 Type II status, HIPAA BA considerations, and a GDPR DPA if EU patient data is in scope.

Immediate ask from WellBridge security: start the vendor security questionnaire and provide identity & access evidence for SSO/SCIM/RBAC.

What we (Redwood) will provide by Friday (EOD):
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and SOC attestation date.
- Security overview deck (attached) with our data flows and encryption details.
- SSO/SAML metadata (SAML 2.0 metadata XML) and SCIM capability notes.

What we need from you:
- The vendor security questionnaire you mentioned on the call (if you can attach it to replies, that’ll get the intake moving).
- A point of contact on the WellBridge security/procurement side for any clarifying questions.
- Desired timeline for security review and procurement (target go-live window).

ID & Access specifics we’d like to nail down:
- SAML binding preference (HTTP-Redirect vs HTTP-POST) and SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated flows.
- SCIM provisioning scope (users only vs groups/roles; 1-way vs 2-way).
- RBAC admin model and any separation-of-duty requirements for admin roles.

Attachments: redwood-security-deck.pdf (high level), quick evidence checklist included in the deck.

Next steps: if you can put the questionnaire in reply and share Erin (security) as the intake owner, Priyom (cc'd) will run the evidence intake and loop in our SOC point. Ben will coordinate contracting/times.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short follow-up call if that speeds things up.

—
Chloe Martin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@wellbridge.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Erin McKay <erin.mckay@wellbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 14:20:37 -0400
Subject: Re: Security & ID proofing: SSO/SCIM evidence request and next steps

Chloe — thanks for the clear recap. Attaching our standard security questionnaire (WellBridge_RFP_Security_Form.xlsx) and adding Erin McKay from our security team to the thread — she'll own intake.

High level timeline:
- Security intake/review: target 2 weeks from receipt (we can accelerate if the SOC2 docs and SAML metadata are available immediately).
- Procurement/legal review: 3–4 weeks (depends on contract redlines).
- Pilot/PoC: ideally mid-August if all checks complete.

On SSO/SCIM specifics: we prefer SP-initiated SAML and HTTP-POST, and SCIM should at minimum support user provisioning and deprovisioning (groups preferred but not required). For RBAC we’ll provide a matrix in the questionnaire — Erin will flag anything unique.

Attachment: WellBridge_RFP_Security_Form.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

—
Alex Turner
Head of Platform Ops | WellBridge Health
alex.turner@wellbridge.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Security & ID proofing: SSO/SCIM evidence request and next steps

Thanks Alex/Erin — Priyom from Redwood security here. I’ll own the evidence intake and clarifications. Quick checklist and what we'll deliver to help you with the questionnaire: 

Redwood deliverables (estimated by Friday EOD):
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II report + attestation date.
- DPA and standard data processing terms for GDPR + our HIPAA BA flow (how PHI is isolated and audit logs are retained).
- SAML metadata XML and configuration guide (SP metadata, ACS URLs, cert thumbprint).
- SCIM support doc (endpoints, supported attributes, provisioning examples) and CSV template for initial user sync.
- RBAC admin matrix sample and notes on separation of duties for account admins.

Questions for WellBridge (so we can populate your spreadsheet and cut turnaround):
1) Do you require signed BAA before any PHI testing?
2) Which SCIM attributes are mandatory for you (email, externalId, displayName, orgUnit)?
3) Any required SAML nameID formats (transient, persistent, emailAddress)?

Attachment: id-access-evidence-template.csv (text/csv) — this contains the fields we typically fill into questionnaires to speed the process.

I’ll follow up with a small packet and a suggested evidence mapping (question -> doc) to make the intake work easier for your team. If convenient, we can also run a 30-min technical sync (SAML+SCIM+RBAC) next week. Proposed slots: Tue 10–11am or Wed 2–3pm PT.

—
